review_scope: 11 mass-route releases; 23 recording/channel attempts. Five release windows proposed on both channels; six releases remain blocked. No user/staff acceptance.

windows.reason: Continuation begins in dry-release tail after app-crash gap. Later full pulse near 08:24 belongs to a separate solution wave; cannot substitute it for this dry release.

windows.reason: Dry-release pulse ends at/near peak before app-crash gap; tail is not captured in this segment.

windows.reason: Two distinct pulses and unresolved event clock; selected dry release is first pulse near 08:07. Coarse sampling and unresolved pairing prevent defensible complete single-pulse/mass estimate.

Inspected native proposal plot and processed samples on both channels. Distinct single pulse; pre window before observed onset; late post window after major tail decay with near-flat observed level. Pulse boundaries are interior to recording. End residual and background drift remain sensitivity limitations, not proof of complete salt recovery; no tail extrapolation. Linear pre/post background and explicit edge/background sensitivity required. User signoff pending.
